note: All target implementation tasks unexecuted. Sequential dependency baseline; optional gates may be excluded from a declared release scope.

tasks.title: Fix secure-context and persistence errors
tasks.scope: Detect unavailable crypto/storage before mutation; make task+event write atomic and show actionable failure.
tasks.acceptance: Plain HTTP error, denied storage, quota failure and reload leave no partial tasks.

tasks.title: Serialize audit producers
tasks.scope: Single event queue plus revision check; validate complete stored records.
tasks.acceptance: Concurrent torque/task events form one chain; corrupt nested records rejected.

tasks.title: Qualify console interactions
tasks.scope: Test create/read/write scopes, approval/rejection, filters, export, reload, keyboard and mobile.
tasks.acceptance: Browser tests pass on localhost secure context; export recomputes chain; no fabricated cloud status.

tasks.title: Bootstrap monorepo and contracts
tasks.scope: Pin runtimes, lockfiles, contract generation, formatting and CI.
tasks.acceptance: Clean checkout builds; contract drift fails CI; secrets absent.

tasks.title: Implement OIDC workspace identity
tasks.scope: Validate issuer/audience/expiry; server membership and role checks; protect cookie writes.
tasks.acceptance: Two-user tenant isolation, CSRF, logout and expiry tests pass.

tasks.title: Migrate PostgreSQL domain records
tasks.scope: Create task revisions, events, approvals, artifacts, jobs and outbox with tenant constraints.
tasks.acceptance: Fresh migration and upgrade pass; foreign tenant IDs denied.

tasks.title: Replace localStorage task source
tasks.scope: API-backed console with durable status and explicit empty/error/loading states.
tasks.acceptance: Two sessions see same task; disconnect/reconnect resumes ordered events.

tasks.title: Implement transition engine
tasks.scope: Versioned task states and immutable revisions; legal transitions only.
tasks.acceptance: Conflicting updates produce one winner; illegal transitions fail.

tasks.title: Implement outbox and leases
tasks.scope: Transactional events, leased jobs, heartbeat, bounded attempts and dead letters.
tasks.acceptance: Kill worker/controller at boundaries; jobs recover without duplicate effects.

tasks.title: Implement cancellation and reconciliation
tasks.scope: Persist cancel request, terminate worker, reconcile uncertain external actions.
tasks.acceptance: Cancel during queue/run/apply reports actual outcome and confirmed worker exit.

tasks.title: Implement deterministic policy tiers
tasks.scope: Map actions to reviewed policies; model recommendation cannot override.
tasks.acceptance: Prompt injection cannot elevate tool access or self-approve.

tasks.title: Implement action-bound approvals
tasks.scope: Digest binds task revision, arguments, artifact, destination, policy, expiry, nonce and budget.
tasks.acceptance: Alter each field and replay/expire/revoke approval: all denied.

tasks.title: Implement execution-time capability gate
tasks.scope: Check authorization again immediately before side effects; transactional nonce/idempotency handling.
tasks.acceptance: TOCTOU artifact swap and concurrent replay cannot execute changed/duplicate action.

tasks.title: Implement budget reservations
tasks.scope: Per-workspace/task limits; reserve before work, settle observed usage and block unknown strict-free spend.
tasks.acceptance: Concurrent tasks cannot overspend; absent pricing/credits blocks strict-free mode.

tasks.title: Qualify CPU Kata host
tasks.scope: Prove virtualization support, runtime selection and actual microVM boundary on selected host.
tasks.acceptance: Retain host/runtime versions and isolation evidence; unsupported host marked blocked.

tasks.title: Build disposable job worker
tasks.scope: No host socket/mounts/metadata; non-root, resource/time limits, deny-by-default network.
tasks.acceptance: Host path, metadata, cross-tenant network and resource exhaustion attacks blocked.

tasks.title: Implement scoped artifact service
tasks.scope: Immutable content-addressed objects, size bounds and short-lived scoped access.
tasks.acceptance: Hash mismatch, foreign workspace object, expired token and overwritten object denied.

tasks.title: Execute real code-change fixture
tasks.scope: Agent emits patch, locked dependencies, actual tests and complete exit/log artifacts.
tasks.acceptance: Fixture change builds/tests in isolated worker; intentionally broken change fails.

tasks.title: Discover Nebius capabilities
tasks.scope: Authenticated model catalog plus separate bounded inference/tool/schema probes.
tasks.acceptance: Exact returned IDs captured; inaccessible/retired IDs fail closed.

tasks.title: Implement inference gateway
tasks.scope: Logical roles, approved privacy class, deadlines, token caps, streamed cancellation and usage.
tasks.acceptance: Timeout/rate limit/provider outage paths bounded; no unauthorized fallback.

tasks.title: Evaluate Dragon Router
tasks.scope: Representative labeled tasks; measure route quality, spend and escalation misses.
tasks.acceptance: Publish evaluation dataset/version and error metrics; no assumed 90/10 split.

tasks.title: Qualify private inference mode
tasks.scope: Review service route, DNS, packet/log data flow, retention and region controls.
tasks.acceptance: Private mode enabled only with retained network and data handling evidence.

tasks.title: Implement MCP registry
tasks.scope: Standards-compatible transport, reviewed schemas, pinned tool identities and capability mapping.
tasks.acceptance: Unknown tool/changed schema denied; protocol interop tests pass.

tasks.title: Implement bounded coding workflow
tasks.scope: Plan, patch and test within task grant; tool output always untrusted.
tasks.acceptance: Malicious repo/tool text cannot read secrets, broaden targets or approve action.

tasks.title: Implement staging deploy adapter
tasks.scope: Deploy application artifacts to approved container target, not a generic model endpoint.
tasks.acceptance: Target digest observed; repeated idempotency key returns same action.

tasks.title: Specify bounded guest predicates
tasks.scope: Publish canonical manifest schema, explicit trusted inputs and expected journal semantics.
tasks.acceptance: Positive/negative vectors cover each predicate; claims exclude unexecuted tests.

tasks.title: Implement real guest and host
tasks.scope: Pinned Rust guest image; deterministic bounded checks; production proof mode.
tasks.acceptance: Real receipt generated; guest source/image provenance retained; no dev receipt accepted.

tasks.title: Implement independent verifier
tasks.scope: Pin image ID; verify seal, decode journal and compare all action commitments.
tasks.acceptance: Forged/truncated/wrong-image/wrong-action/dev/fail-result receipts rejected.

tasks.title: Benchmark proving jobs
tasks.scope: Async job statuses, resource caps, cancellation and hardware/cycle timing evidence.
tasks.acceptance: Observed duration distributions and failure paths; no hardcoded timing claims.

tasks.title: Implement signed audit envelopes
tasks.scope: Canonical tenant sequence, signatures, key rotation and independent export verification.
tasks.acceptance: Mutation, truncation against external checkpoint, reorder and wrong signer detected.

tasks.title: Bind verifier to execution gate
tasks.scope: Verify artifact/policy/action match before accepting approval and applying stage release.
tasks.acceptance: Old valid receipt cannot authorize modified artifact or different destination.

tasks.title: Run complete staging vertical slice
tasks.scope: Real inference, isolated code execution, checks, receipt, approval and observed deployment.
tasks.acceptance: One evidence bundle links source commit through final observed target digest.

tasks.title: Implement encrypted memory store
tasks.scope: Workspace keys, provenance, retention, embeddings and deletion handling.
tasks.acceptance: Key rotation and deletion tests cover source, vectors and derived summaries.

tasks.title: Implement task-bound retrieval grants
tasks.scope: Subject/task revision/purpose/scope/expiry; prequery and postquery checks.
tasks.acceptance: Cross-tenant, expired, revoked, deleted and purpose-mismatched retrieval denied.

tasks.title: Evaluate redaction and injection
tasks.scope: Leakage corpus and hostile memory prompts; minimize inference inputs.
tasks.acceptance: Report false negatives/positives; no absolute zero-PII claim.

tasks.title: Integrate deterministic simulator adapter
tasks.scope: Pin world, policy, seed, timestep and actual sensor/constraint outputs.
tasks.acceptance: Replay reproduces run within documented tolerance; synthetic data clearly labeled.

tasks.title: Define safety manifest and checks
tasks.scope: Bound policy digest, model/calibration, torque/velocity/joint limits and permitted environment.
tasks.acceptance: Boundary and invalid sensor cases fail; proof assumptions explicitly documented.

tasks.title: Implement signed OTA staging
tasks.scope: Device identity, signature, expiry, monotonic release counter and rollback digest.
tasks.acceptance: Forged/expired/replayed/incompatible releases rejected; rollback exercised.

tasks.title: Qualify hardware safety independently
tasks.scope: Physical emergency stop, independent limit controller, communication loss and HIL.
tasks.acceptance: Observed hardware tests pass before enabled physical actions; no remote proof safety dependency.

tasks.title: Implement consented Celestia adapter
tasks.scope: Use qualified current blob API; publish minimal non-sensitive commitments only.
tasks.acceptance: Opt-out prevents all submission; payload inspection excludes raw memory/secrets.

tasks.title: Verify submission inclusion
tasks.scope: Track namespace/height/transaction and independently verify inclusion with failure/reorg policy.
tasks.acceptance: Broadcast alone remains pending; valid inclusion linked to local evidence; fees bounded.

tasks.title: Prepare reviewed Nebius IaC
tasks.scope: Qualified products/region, private service identities, firewall and secret injection.
tasks.acceptance: Recreate staging from clean account config; no unexpected public services.

tasks.title: Migrate UI and complete data-flow inventory
tasks.scope: Self-host assets; inventory DNS/CDN/inference/logs/backups/support and egress.
tasks.acceptance: Sovereignty claims match measured boundaries; no external font/analytics requests.

tasks.title: Implement telemetry and incident controls
tasks.scope: Safe logs, alerts, emergency pause, credential revocation and artifact retention.
tasks.acceptance: Leak sentinel never appears in logs; emergency pause blocks new external actions.

tasks.title: Execute recovery and load drills
tasks.scope: Backup restore, queue replay, uncertain action reconciliation and bounded concurrency.
tasks.acceptance: Measure RPO/RTO and p95 latency with workload/hardware stated; no duplicate writes.

tasks.title: Complete independent security review
tasks.scope: External reviewer assesses auth, isolation, proof binding, privacy and device boundary.
tasks.acceptance: Critical/high findings resolved and retested; review report linked to release commit.

tasks.title: Produce release evidence and demo
tasks.scope: Pin all evidence to final commit and disclose unpassed tracks.
tasks.acceptance: 100-point rubric assessed only from executed evidence; all mandatory gates pass.
